note: What a server sends to say which units a missile struck. The header names the missile.

fields.name: count
fields.note: How many units follow. A client reads it as signed, so a count of zero or above 32767 carries no units, and a server sends at most 32767.

fields.name: targets
fields.note: The units struck, in order. A client still takes a unit it does not know, with nothing shown on it, and nothing after the hit that destroys the missile shows.
